## Product overview

The Amerimax 5 In. traditional, K-style white or brown vinyl hidden hook has a durable vinyl construction and white color. The hook is designed to mount directly to the fascia, every 18 In. to 24 In. along a gutter length. The durable hook has UV stabilizers and can withstand temperatures from -40 to 150 degrees Fahrenheit.

- Use the hidden hook to mount Traditional style vinyl gutter to the roof line
- Crush and dent-proof vinyl construction to withstand extreme temperatures from -40 to 150F
- White finish and Traditional style design for versatility
- No painting required, clean with a hose to keep the vinyl components looking its best
- UV stabilizers help prevent UV light degradation
- Mounts directly to the fascia with #8 screws (not included)
- One hook required every 18-in to 24-in along a gutter run
- Fits 5-in K-style Traditional vinyl gutter
- Most of the assembly can be completed on the ground
- Lifetime guarantee
